page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/pr-appr-resolve.md` for the full workflow. Pull latest before starting. Fetch all review comments via `gh api`. Triage each comment: fix in code, won't fix (intentional), won't fix (already addressed), won't fix (pre-existing), or won't fix (disagree) — applying `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`'s occurrence-inventory and cross-file-propagation methodology before drafting each code fix, and its Phase 4 checklist across the full PR diff before posting replies — per that Skill's Phase 2 scope note, "changed files" means every file in the PR diff across all commits, not only the files this pass edits or the files with open comments. Present the triage plan as a table and get user approval before posting any replies or resolving any threads. Every comment gets a reply and every thread gets resolved.
